messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - high error/timeout rate observed for inference-gateway-prod. Alert ALERT_INF_GW_ERRORS fired at 2026-03-15T11:04:31Z. Approx 18% 5xx and 12% timeouts (tcp) across eu region. Paging primary on-call @lee. PD: PD-98765 <https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765|link>

lee: ack. jumping in. quick ask: is this a deploy or upstream provider issue?

infra-bot: recent events - deploys: inference-gateway v2.9.2 by deploy-bot at 2026-03-15T09:50:12Z. No other infra changes. Upstream provider metrics show elevated connect latency to provider-eu-01 starting 11:00Z.

anita: Im seeing a flood of 502/504s in the gateway logs, many include `upstream connection reset by peer` and `context deadline exceeded` from our client lib. sample log: `time="2026-03-15T11:03:01Z" level=error msg="proxy: upstream error: context deadline exceeded (client: 10.2.12.45)"`

charles: correlating traces - spike in external latency for requests bound to provider tag `provider:europe-01`. internal retry loop is currently aggressive (5 attempts), which looks like it's amplifying traffic to a flaky upstream.

lee: ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce retries from 5 -> 1 for external provider calls, 2) enable provider circuit breaker (open after 50 errors in 2m for provider), 3) shift EU traffic away from provider:europe-01 to provider:europe-02 and provider:global-failover. Applying changes in that order so we don't overload failovers.

anita: making config change to `client_retry_policy.max_attempts=1` and adding CB config `consecutive_errors:50, interval:2m, open_duration:5m`. pushing to two gateway replicas as canary now.

infra-bot: canary started: change-id canary-1810004. Monitoring error rate on canary pods.

charles: while canary runs, can we suppress noisy pages? This alert has paged 4 times in past week for short spikes. We should avoid paging on brief flaps.

lee: agreed. current alert rule pages on 5xx_rate > 10% for 1m. That's too sensitive. Suggest we change to sustained 5xx > 8% for 5m OR 5xx_count > 300 in 5m. Also add grouping and severity label by `provider` and `region`.

anita: proposed Prometheus rule to replace AL: 
```yaml
- alert: InferenceGatewayHigh5xx
  expr: |
    (
      sum by (region, provider) (increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m]))
      /
      sum by (region, provider) (increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\"}[5m]))
    ) > 0.08
    and
    sum by (region, provider) (increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) > 300
  for: 4m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained high 5xx rate ({{ $labels.region }}/{{ $labels.provider }})"
    runbook: "https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-gateway-errors"
```

charles: also add an Alertmanager inhibition rule to mute page if there's an active deploy: 
```
inhibit_rules:
- source_match:
    alertname: "DeploymentInProgress"
  target_match:
    severity: "page"
  equal: ["service"]
```
This prevents pages during known deploy windows.

infra-bot: canary config applied to pods gw-canary-1 and gw-canary-2. initial metrics show per-canary 5xx rate dropped from 19% -> 6% within 90s.

lee: great. increase weight to failover pool for EU traffic by 60% (gradual over 2m). also spin up two extra gateway replicas to soak traffic.

anita: failover ramp started. scaling replicas 4 -> 8.

charles: while we do that, let's reduce paging noise by changing Alertmanager route: page only if label `severity=page` AND not labeled `provider=thirdparty-beta` (we don't page for beta providers). Update docs for provider tagging.

lee: note: we should create a dashboard that shows per-provider rolling error rate, timeout count, and request volume. Add panels: "Provider Error Rate (5m)", "Provider 95th Upstream Latency", "Retry amplification (requests/sec)" and a compact heatmap for top 5 providers. Link it in the PD page.

anita: created dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/KBX8L7/inference-provider-ops - panels added. Will add to incident PD page after postmortem.

infra-bot: mitigation successful: global 5xx rate down to 4.2% and timeouts back to baseline in 6m. Canary stable.

lee: moving to monitoring. handing off to next on-call @anita for follow-up ops and postmortem. if anyone wants to join postmortem, I'm scheduling 60m at 2026-03-16T10:00Z.

charles: follow-up action items: 
- tune alert rule as proposed and push to staging (owner: charles)
- add Alertmanager inhibit rule for deploys (owner: charles)
- add provider grouping to PD escalation policy so ops only pages on provider-wide impact (owner: ops-team)
- update runbook to include retry limit and circuit-breaker params + example curl test + `provider:tag` troubleshooting steps (owner: lee)
- run chaos test in staging to determine safe circuit-breaker thresholds (owner: anita)

anita: assigning tasks and will update the ticket PD-98765 -> postmortem queue. also will contact provider-europe-01 account rep to report flapping and request SLA review.

pagerduty: PD-98765 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled and linked in incident notes. Escalations suppressed for now.

lee: quick note on runbook snippets to add (so we don't forget): 
- `curl -v -H \"X-Request-ID: test\" https://inference-gateway.prod/api/v1/health` to check gateway path to provider
- `kubectl logs -l app=inference-gateway -c proxy --since=5m | grep provider:europe-01` for focused logs
- PromQL for provider error rate: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\", provider=~\"europe-.*\", status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (provider) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\", provider=~\"europe-.*\"}[5m])) by (provider)`

charles: +1. Also add a note to temporarily lower internal retry concurrency (limit concurrent inflight retries to avoid retry storms).

anita: thanks everyone. closing thread - moving incident to mitigated and follow-ups in PD ticket. will post postmortem doc link here after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
